title: CTA and oncofetal candidate selection
definition: An OncoRef CTA candidate is a reference-resolved protein with supported cancer expression and qualifying reproductive or developmental association that passes the named normal-tissue evidence, coverage and selection rules. Sequence realization requires separately qualified translation records.

categories.CTA: Candidate under the named policy; not presentation or clinical clearance
categories.Unsafe: Normal-tissue or applicable clinical evidence establishes policy exclusion
categories.Other: Not admitted; inspect every reason and assessment status

assessment_states.screened: Declared assessment completed; not exhaustive biological coverage
assessment_states.incomplete_evidence: Required coverage or evidence resolution is incomplete
assessment_states.normal_evidence_hold: Normal evidence requires review without establishing exclusion
assessment_states.unassessed: No applicable selection policy or no completed assessment

interpretation_states.accepted: The specified observation is supported within its recorded scope
interpretation_states.unresolved: A material identity, assay, context or interpretation question remains
interpretation_states.rejected: The claimed observation is not supported; retain the rationale and source

interpretation_note: Review completion, interpretation and policy effect are separate. A completed review may retain unresolved evidence; a rejected claim is not proof of absence.
support_route_note: Routes may overlap; a developmental route is not adult testis restriction

sequence_roles.exclude: Retain applicable exclusion evidence; it takes precedence across occurrences
sequence_roles.review: Evidence, identity, coverage or sequence qualification needs resolution
sequence_roles.allow: No exclusion from this assessed record under the named policy

translation_scope: This decision interface does not qualify every translation or isoform
consumer_scope: Use explicitly qualified records as a reference for exact subtraction or approximate near-self screening. Preserve every source occurrence and coverage gap. Patient-HLA prediction, similarity cutoffs and intervention rules are downstream policy; exact matching does not validate approximate matching.
prohibited_shortcuts: Blanket exemption of historical CTA nominations from normal-reference evidence
A second legacy IHC filter that silently drops exclusions from other evidence
Interpreting Other, absent records or unmeasured panels as negative normal evidence
Transfer of human numerical rules to another species by symbol or orthology
